Lord '''Emares''' is a [[Tairen]] Lord. His army is a member of the [[Great Coalition]] during the [[Aiel War]].

== History ==
It is Lord Emares' idea to use [[Lan]]'s army as the anvil to his army's hammer, a plan to defeat the [[Aiel]] near the geologic formation called the Hook. The plan is not quite executed as the Aiel retreat after recognizing Lan's army even though Lan's army is small in comparison.
